scientific_integrity: M1 exact finite two-block certificate and nested-recurrence cross-check were replayed; M2 induction follows from cited digit description; no inference from finite sampling to infinite absence.
scientific_limitations: The complete palindrome spectrum is calculated only for M1; for M2 only infinitely many palindromic prefixes are established. No independent validation or historical-priority guarantee.
title: Palindromic spectra of two meta-automatic binary words
